blocks.text: Aali Singh and his companion test Banda inwardly, but when they arrive he greets them in Khalsa fashion, reveals insight into their condition, and redirects all marvel back toward the Guru’s grace.
He tells them plainly that the delay in action comes from waiting for more Singhs and strengthening the coalition, not from fear or indecision.
The page centers recognition, inward testing, and the repeated name of Vahiguru as marks of legitimate authority rather than cheap miracle.
